```{r setup}
library(Jiepac)
```


## Example data

The package includes maternal mortality data from
the World Bank.

```{r}
data("mater", package = "Jiepac")

head(mater)
```

## Preprocess the data

The `wbfun()` function converts mortality data from
wide format to long format.

```{r}
matmor <- wbfun(mater, "matmor")

head(matmor)
```

## Output

The processed dataset contains three variables:

- `iso`: Country ISO code
- `year`: Year from 2000 to 2019
- `matmor`: Maternal mortality values

Each row represents one country in one year.
